# Openflip

> Openflip is a social network for sharing photos and short videos. Users post, like, comment, follow, and discover creators through hashtags and a curated feed.

## Pages

- [Home feed](/): Personalized feed of photos and short videos from people you follow.
- [Explore](/explore): Trending posts, reels, hashtags, and creator discovery.
- [Reels](/reels): Full-screen short-form video feed.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Overview of secure messaging and platform basics.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in.

## Optional
